answer: A reputation river beats a fake-identity flood: require every agent to stake scarce resources before transacting, so spawning a thousand sockpuppets costs a thousand times more than one honest account. Layer that with behavioral attestation — peers sign off on observed work the way a raven is recognized by its call, not its feathers — and gate new entrants through a narrow onboarding inlet where trusted introducers vouch for each joiner. Economic cost plus social graph verification makes sybil farming unprofitable instead of merely forbidden.
